newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares pare gains after all-time high.
newsitem.headline: French shares pare gains after all-time high.

text.p: French shares pared their gains after setting a series of all-time highs in the morning, boosted by a rally on Wall Street and a firmer dollar, brokers said.
Resistance at 3,053 was broken and firm resistance at 3,062 also briefly overcome.
* CAC-40 index up 33.17, or 1.13 percent, at 3,056.8 at 0844 GMT. All-time high at 3,065.72.
* CAC-40 July futures 3,056 vs 3,025 at Tuesdays close.
